description:
Ship the 'bash' built-in tool.

=== Scope ===

- 'lernie tool bash' subcommand on the lernie binary.
- JSON input with { command: <string> } (final shape pinned by ball #1); the subcommand execs 'sh -c <command>' and captures stdout/stderr per the pinned stdio contract.
- SIGTERM is forwarded to the child process group so a bash-spawned subprocess tree exits cleanly when the harness cancels (§2.9 cascade, within the deadline ball #1 pins).
- JSON Schema at schemas/tools/bash.json.
- SKILL.md under template/.agent/system/tools/bash/SKILL.md.
- Integration test through the tool executor (ball #4).

=== Depends on ===

bl-7c2a.

=== Out of scope ===

- Sandboxing / capability restriction (ARCH §1.1 non-goal for v1).
- Interactive stdin passthrough.
- Oversized-output auto-dispatch (epic non-goal).
title: v0.3 built-in tool: bash
